zoe: quick note 1: planning EU canary for emerald-v1 tonight. change window 21:30 UTC. small blast, need ops+infra+trust signoff.
kevin: ack. what's exact canary flow?
zoe: plan: 5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100% across two windows. keep pins in eu-west only until full cutover.
sam: fallback ladder suggestion: emerald-lowlat, emerald-quant, aurora-7b. lowlat first because it's fastest when under load.
tia: add that emerald-lowlat is slightly more expensive; set cost alert. also want quality smoke tests in runbook.
zoe: runbook includes smoke-eval set + A/B sampling against aurora baseline. also release notes: emerald-v1 includes tokenization fix, KV-cache micro-optimizations, and quant-aware kernels.
kevin: pin/drain semantics?
sam: pin the catalog entry to emerald-v1 for the canary percentage windows. drain older variants from warm pool with graceful timeout 90s. mark pinned variants with tag canary-eu-<date>.
zoe: add explicit pin expiry: auto-unpin after 48h unless an owner extends. keeps cruft low.
tia: telemetry checklist: p50/p95/p99 lat, 5xx rate, token cost per request, cache hit ratio, and quality delta (BLEU/ROUGE-ish smoke metrics + human spot check). thresholds: p99 > baseline *1.25 or 5xx >2% -> auto rollback. quality delta >4% on smoke-eval -> manual rollback.
kevin: suggest soft-thresholds for traffic-scaling: if p95 > +12% but 5xx <1.5% then step back one phase and hold 20m.
zoe: agreed. owner assignments: ops oncall=kevin, infra=sam, trust=tia, rollback owner=kevin.
kevin: I'll own rollback. rollback plan: pin aurora-7b at last-good hash and unpin emerald variants, clear warm caches, and force-routing to aurora.
deploybot: DeployBot scheduled canary: model=emerald-v1 region=eu-west start=1749961800 (2025-03-08T21:30:00Z) phases=5%:25%:75%:100% runbook=https://go/release/emerald-eu-canary
zoe: @deploybot attach release notes and changelog to the thread?
deploybot: DeployBot: release-notes attached: https://go/release/emerald-v1/notes, changelog: https://go/release/emerald-v1/changelog. smoke-eval job queued.
kevin: please enable span sampling and request tracing for the first 60m of the canary.
deploybot: DeployBot: tracing enabled for ttl=60m. will post telemetry every 45s. :robot_face:
sam: posting rollout-config in repo in morning with variant-normalize shim. will include tokenization compat test.
tia: adding human spot-check rota: tia, olga, ben for first 90m. please share examples in thread.
deploybot: DeployBot: phase=5% started ts=1749961800.
deploybot: DeployBot: telemetry snapshot: p95 +2%, 5xx 0.2%, token-cost +3%, quality delta +0.5% (smoke-eval sample).
zoe: good so far. hold 5% for 15m per runbook.
deploybot: DeployBot: phase->25% ts=1749962700. telemetry snapshot: p95 +9%, 5xx 0.7%, token-cost +2.8%, cache-hit -1.2%, quality delta +1.6%.
kevin: p95 up 9% but 5xx <2% -> per soft policy step back to 10% and extend observation 15m.
deploybot: DeployBot: traffic adjusted to 10% by kevin. posting next snapshot in 45s.
sam: checking warm pool logs: drains showing planned terminations, no spike in start failures.
tia: running smoke-eval now, uploading sample diffs to thread: https://go/eval/emerald-eu-smoke/1749962740
deploybot: DeployBot: telemetry snapshot: p95 +6%, 5xx 0.4%, quality delta +1.2%.
zoe: metrics improving after step-back; hold 10% and re-evaluate for 25% in 30m.
kevin: if anything crosses auto-rollback thresholds I'll execute rollback.
deploybot: DeployBot: scheduled phase->75% at ts=1749964600 pending manual approval. awaiting kevin approval.
kevin: approving proceed to 75% at ts=1749964620.
deploybot: DeployBot: phase->75% ts=1749964620. telemetry snapshot: p95 +11%, 5xx 1.6%, quality delta +2.2%.
sam: noticing cache-hit ratio drop on longer prompts, might be kv-cache miss behavior; investigate cache warmers.
tia: human spot-checks show minor hallucination shifts but within acceptable bounds. documenting in release notes.
kevin: p95 +11% and 5xx <2% -> acceptable. hold at 75% until next window.
zoe: next window tomorrow for full 100% unless we see regression. postmortem owner = zoe. keep thread open for follow-ups.
deploybot: DeployBot: canary complete (holds at 75%). will post final telemetry snapshot at 1749965600.
